body:

Seat 1's post is #7623. Body **r49** (R4: PR #23807 approved and PASS, its landing stroke refused by the classifier and held for the maintainer; PRs #23751 and #23766 held only by `skip-changeset`), written 2026-10-16T04:18Z by `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7` (os-elon-musk); r48, r47, r46, r45, r44, r43, r42, r41, r40, r39, r38, r37, r36, r35, r34, r33 (seating) and r32 (the previous shift's sign-off ledger, `session_012dGTuJen61ECNHXYXKChoC`, os-justin) are in the edit history, ⛔ not restated.

## Current PM

🟢 **os-elon-musk** — `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`, seated on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills seat 2` in this session; the round-open marker is the comment stamped after this body. Default wake-up Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw` (hourly at :16, self-bound to this session). Batch **3** (the seating default; no maintainer word on concurrency in this session). Seat 1 (#7623) reads ⏳ vacant since its sign-off around 12:29Z, so this is the lane's only seated PM. Each card's newest `Claim:` `Seat:` line says whose it is.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **From r32:** nothing owed. #22978 and #22585 (r32's two `pm:blocked`) were claimed and closed by seat 1; `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161) unchanged. r32's relay items 3–5 stand as recorded there (the relay-credential rotation question on objectstack-ai/objectui#12212 stays with the maintainer; the two lane-table observations; `check:platform-checklist` is the watchdog's).
- **Lane now** (objectstack; objectui 0 open `domain:skills`): `pm:queue` 1.
  - #23787 (p2, filed by `domain:spec` seat 1, first-graded by triage 6207123004) left the queue in R4; see below.
  - #23770 (p3, `bug`, filed and self-triaged by this seat): `os-dev.md` L295 「⛔ 不抬 ceiling」 against ruling 6184799323 B item 1. It is serial behind PR #23766, which edits the same file.
  - The decision box is empty. `pm:blocked`, `pm:on-hold` and `pm:retriage` are 0.
- **This seat's cards (R1):**
  - #23615 — **landed**: PR #23669 `547702080`, Tier H, approved and enqueued by `os-zhuang` before the at-tier review could run (tier at its usage limit); landing comment 6192063883.
  - #23662 — **landed**: PR #23675 `3b46855fb` (Tier S, at-tier PASS 6202676185); landing comment on the card.
  - #23607 — **landed**: PR #23676 `1b9e526d1` (Tier S, at-tier PASS 6202616611); landing comment on the card.
  - Both landing strokes ran on the maintainer's 「同意你复核落地」 in this session, after the classifier refusals (6202646278, 6202691212).
  - #23606 was lost to seat 1 (yield note on the card).
- **This seat's cards (R2):**
  - #23692 — **landed**: PR #23750 `29c7157af` (Tier S, at-tier PASS 6205051403); landing comment 6205364689.
  - #23733 — PR #23751: ACCEPT 6204912477, at-tier PASS 6205062630 on `5629c6ff6`.
  - #23665 — PR #23766: ACCEPT 6205486800, at-tier PASS 6205619558 on `5e548689e`. The `os-dev.md` ceiling rises 402 → 404 under 6184799323 B, quoting 6190922830.
  - **Both PRs are held only by `skip-changeset`.** The R2 dev's write of it was refused by the session's permission classifier, so the seat does not re-issue it and holds it for the maintainer's word. `Check Changeset` is each PR's only red.
  - Open questions for the maintainer, non-blocking, on the cards:
    - `yes (narrowing)` → the narrowing face? (#23692, 6205078148)
    - first-touch labels for 例外二 cards? (#23733, 6205096053)
- **This seat's cards (R3):**
  - #23768 — **landed**: PR #23793 `2fdfb5d23` (Tier H, approved by `os-zhuang`; at-tier PASS 6207130667 on `5dd8c0a8c`); landing comment 6207452123.
  - #23753 — **landed**: PR #23795 `b711056e6` (Tier H, approved by `os-zhuang`; at-tier PASS 6207254097 on `9fc1d4717`); landing comment 6207458801.
  - Both merged by the queue at 2026-10-16T03:24Z, byte-identical to the reviewed heads.
  - PR #23793's record corrects the seat's ACCEPT: the two families the dev did not measure run in `Build Core`, not `Lint · repo & tooling gates`. `Build Core` is green on the head.
- **This seat's cards (R4):**
  - #23787 — claim 6207374288, dispatch order 6207401165. PR #23807 on `b4ea19079`: ACCEPT 6207794824, APPROVED by `os-zhuang` (review 5542940388), at-tier PASS 6207942851, CI 47/47 with 0 failures, `clean`. The first landing stroke (`label-write --remove needs:contract-review`) was refused by the classifier (`CI Bypass`), recorded on the card (6207961280). `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable` were not attempted; the PR stays draft for the maintainer's word or an approver's landing. It is the skill and ADR-0088 half of ruling C′ item 2 on #23128; PR #23785 (`domain:spec` seat 1) carries the spec half.
  - The dev measured three cases with no app-declarable door (a third-party-signed callback, a streaming response, an unspoken protocol). They are put to the maintainer on the card (6207817517), non-blocking, with the seat recommending A (keep the gap) for each.
- The review's one non-blocking note: "rate limit" in the retire sentence shared with PR #23785 should read "endpoint rate-limit budget". A pointer for `domain:spec` seat 1 is on #23216 (6207969413); the skill's copy follows whichever way it lands.
- **In flight 0** · **Landing windows 3**: PRs #23807, #23751 and #23766, each held for the maintainer's word · **decision box 0**.

## Hot-file serial queue

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` · `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: FROZEN (ruling 208 R6). Every other lane file: FREE.

## Notes

- **Write paths:** content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`issue_patch` for this post's title and PR bodies); route `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`, Actions `active`); ⛔ no MCP write.
- **Harness:** CURRENT at `46ca793ed`. The shared checkout was fast-forwarded `--ff-only` at each round boundary: `57994c311` → `3b46855fb` → `1ac24f2f8` → `0a168a33e` → `46ca793ed`. The four-axis block's md5 is unchanged (`abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`).
- **Served tier:** `get_session` `last_served_model` is the `TIER_DEFAULT` build ⇒ at-tier contract reviews run in an isolated at-tier subagent; ⛔ no self-review above the seat's tier. The seven-day quota reads `allowed_warning`.
- **Quota wall ended.** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` refused this session from 12:03Z to 20:18Z (twelve HTTP 429s). It answered after the 21:00Z reset, and both at-tier reviews PASSed. The reviewer transcripts carry 57 and 67 at-tier stamps and 0 at any other tier.
- **Classifier refusal, resolved.** The Tier S landing strokes were refused at 2026-10-15T21:27Z (`Merge Without Review`, `CI Bypass`), and the seat stopped and reported. The maintainer answered 「同意你复核落地」 in this session, and the same commands then ran (relay run 38819636530). Both PRs merged by the queue at 2026-10-15T23:06Z.
- **Carried for the shift brief** (not cards, under the filing gate):
  - **Platform fact:** `references/platform-readings.md` L171 documents the single-issue page payload as `payload.preloadedQueries[0].result.data.repository.issue` with `frontTimelineItems`. Measured live by the #23615 dev and by the seat 2026-10-15T11:59Z: the `react-app.embeddedData` block carrying `bodyHTML` holds `payload.issueViewerRoute.data.repository.issue`, with `timelineItems` / `backTimelineItems`.
  - **Principle:** `SKILL.md` L265 「…四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它」 names no axis-④ new-gate exception, now that `decision-analysis.md` does (PR #23675). The #23662 dev reads L266 as reconciling the two.
  - **Principle:** `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`'s report JSON template has no `deviations` key, while three of its lines (one new, from PR #23676) and the dispatch orders name one.
  - **Escalated by the at-tier review on PR #23795**, not cards under the filing gate (code-reading findings with no measured `reach:`). The `editMode` item is decision-shaped and was put to the maintainer in chat.
    - **`editMode` against `navigation.mode`.** A list view's `navigation.mode` does not reach create/edit in the shipped console, while the object's declared `editMode` (`object.zod.ts` L2805, honoured by objectui's `recordFormNavigation.ts`) does. The derivation docblock (`record-surface.ts` L150–152) omits `editMode`, and ADR-0085 §2 rejects presentation toggles on the object.
    - **objectui F1.** The console's task flows ignore the derived `surface` (`AppContent.tsx` L1209, L1231–1238), so a light record's create/edit opens a modal, not a drawer.
    - **objectui F2.** The console's view flow derives without the viewport (app-shell `ObjectView.tsx` L2657), so a light record on a phone opens a drawer, not a page. Its `objectDef.navigation` fallback (L2640) reads a key the object schema refuses.
    - **Spec F3, wording.** `record-surface.ts`'s header docblock (L4–6, L13) still says 「full page」 for create/edit.
  - **Stale text after PR #23750:** the frozen `dispatch-gates.mjs` L12013, `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` L1062 and `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` L9961 comments say "three contract faces", and so does `references/lanes/ui.md` L38 (契约三面).
- **Timers and subscriptions:** Routine `trig_0146Bbf4fhg7HqoFCFCYGvWw`. `subscribe_pr_activity` is open on PRs #23751, #23766 and #23807; those on PRs #23750, #23793 and #23795 ended at their merges. Each further PR is subscribed the moment its report names it. Worktrees: all three R2 worktrees were removed by their devs.
